topic.readerProblem: Regression-test a citation URL comparison policy without overwriting the raw URL or silently changing source counts.
topic.connection: Citation URL grouping directly affects how AEOeye-style audits count sources, domains, and repeated evidence across AI answers.

assessment: The page delivers an executable, conservative syntax-normalization suite with twenty populated adversarial cases. It preserves raw URLs, retains functional queries, rejects malformed inputs, and explicitly refuses to infer redirects, canonical equivalence, ownership, or live retrieval behavior.

sources.supports: Generic URI components, parsing boundaries, relative resolution, and dot-segment concepts.
The modern URL parsing and processing model referenced as a syntax layer.
The canonical link relation and its preferred-resource semantics, not automatic evidence replacement.
Google's current canonicalization guidance and the distinction between signals and guaranteed selection.
The standard-library URL parsing and joining primitives used in the implementation.

checks: Executed normalize_urls.py over all twenty rows and compared the generated CSV byte-for-byte with expected.csv.
Manually inspected default-port, dot-segment, percent-encoding, query, fragment, relative-reference, malformed-port, and unsupported-scheme cases against the stated policy.
Read the final article and opened all five primary sources, both images, and every linked resource after replacing a dead directory-style link.

artifacts.description: Dependency-free syntax normalizer with a deliberately conservative HTTP and HTTPS comparison policy.
Twenty populated synthetic and adversarial URL cases with optional bases and review decisions.
Checked deterministic keys, statuses, decisions, and notes for byte-level regression testing.
Exact run instructions and the boundary between syntax comparison and web-equivalence claims.

methodology: The review ran the implementation against the full twenty-case fixture, verified the generated bytes, inspected each transformation category, confirmed that malformed and non-HTTP inputs are rejected, and checked that no code path performs a network request or substitutes canonical and redirect claims.
limitations: The suite cannot establish reachability, redirect history, canonical selection, content identity, authorship, ownership, freshness, internationalized-domain safety, or what an answer engine retrieved.
